note: Leek Building Society Annual Report & Accounts 2025, year to 31 December 2025. Capital structure table in note 23 (PDF p42, printed p82-83), in GBP 000: general and other reserves 84,049 less PVA (117) and intangibles (2,346) = CET1 81,586; Tier 2 collective provision 574; total regulatory capital 82,160. RWA is stated only rounded, 'increased to £495m', in the CFO review (PDF p8), which also gives CET1 ratio 16.5%, leverage ratio 6.0% and LCR 241% at 31 December 2025. Check: 81,586/495,000 = 16.48%. The report states no total capital ratio: 16.6% is its own total capital over its own rounded RWA (82,160/495,000 = 16.60%). No leverage exposure or NSFR stated. Society only.
